page.notes: The left strip of the page is shadowed and cut off by the scan, so the first letters of several lines are partly hidden; the readings there follow the surviving strokes and are not certain. Show-through and fragments of the facing page are at the left edge and were left out. The running head is very faint and could not be read with certainty. Line "tr. §. 31." is the continuation of "Arbi-" and its first letters are cut off, so it is marked [?]. Blue pen marks on the right were left out.
